federal_updates.headline: Bipartisan Senators File Bill To Keep Hemp THC Products Federally Legal As Next Month's Scheduled Ban Looms - Marijuana Moment
federal_updates.summary: Bipartisan senators have introduced legislation aimed at preserving the federal legality of hemp-derived THC products amid an impending ban scheduled for next month.
federal_updates.impact: This bill could prevent disruption in the hemp THC product market nationwide, including Michigan, by maintaining federal legality and avoiding a ban that could affect supply and sales.
federal_updates.recommended_action: Monitor the progress of this bill closely as its passage could stabilize the hemp THC market and supply chain. Prepare to adjust sourcing and product offerings accordingly.

federal_updates.headline: USPS Says Medical Marijuana Isn't Mailable 'Under Any Circumstances,' But Weighs Possible Policy Change Under Rescheduling - Marijuana Moment

federal_updates.impact: A policy shift could open new delivery channels for medical cannabis, impacting distribution logistics and expanding market reach for retailers including those in Michigan.
federal_updates.recommended_action: Stay informed on USPS policy developments to evaluate potential new delivery options for medical cannabis products, which could enhance customer service and market expansion.
